query:
insert into TracesCoveredByFailedTests (
                agg_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                file_collect_nr,
                filepath,
                file_hash,
                traced_line
            )
            select distinct
                agg_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                file_collect_nr,
                filepath,
                file_hash,
                traced_line
            from TraceMappedLinesCoveredByFailedTests
            where agg_collect_nr = $1

            on conflict (
                agg_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                filepath,
                traced_line
            ) do update
            set
                file_collect_nr = max(TracesCoveredByFailedTests.file_collect_nr, excluded.file_collect_nr),
                file_hash = excluded.file_hash
